About Lyte
 Lyte builds perception systems for Physical AI operating in complex environments. The company combines custom silicon, integrated sensors, and software into a unified platform for robotics, mobility, and next-generation automation. Lyte is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with a global presence. For more information, visit www.lyte.ai
 If you’re excited about building impactful technology in a dynamic, hands-on environment, we’d love to hear from you!
 About The Role
We are seeking a QA / DevOps Engineer to build and maintain the CI/CD, test automation, and infrastructure that keep quality high across our embedded software. You will be a force multiplier for every engineering team, from firmware bring-up to production release.
 What You'll Do
Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for embedded, firmware, and application software
Develop and maintain automated test frameworks (unit, integration, system, and hardware-in-the-loop)
Manage build, artifact, and release infrastructure across heterogeneous targets
Administer version control, code review, and branching workflows (Git / GitLab)
Provision and maintain cloud and on-prem infrastructure (AWS) and containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes)
Track quality metrics, coverage, and regressions; drive continuous improvement
Support hardware-in-the-loop and factory test automation
Champion QA best practices and release readiness across teams
 Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
5+ years in QA automation, DevOps, or software infrastructure
Strong scripting in Python and Bash
Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems (GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions)
Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Familiarity with test automation frameworks and code-coverage tooling
Version control and code-review workflow expertise (Git)
 Preferred Qualifications
Embedded/firmware test automation and HIL experience 
Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible)
Experience with RTOS/Linux embedded build systems
Observability tooling (logging, metrics, dashboards)
Robotics or safety-critical software background
 Benefits (subject to location and local regulations)
Competitive salary and equity 
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage 
401(k) retirement plan 
Flexible vacation and time-off policy 
Collaborative, fast-paced, and inclusive work environment 
Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies with a highly cross-functional team 
 The Pay Range For This Role Is
 150,000 - 250,000 USD per year(Bay Area, CA)
